framework.name: GDPR — General Data Protection Regulation
framework.description: EU General Data Protection Regulation — key obligations for data controllers and processors.

controls.title: Principles of processing
controls.description: Personal data must be processed lawfully, fairly and transparently; collected for specified purposes; adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary; accurate and kept up to date; kept no longer than necessary; processed securely.

controls.title: Lawful basis for processing
controls.description: Processing shall be lawful only if and to the extent that at least one legal basis applies (consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task, legitimate interests).

controls.title: Transparent information to data subjects
controls.description: The controller shall provide information relating to processing to the data subject in a concise, transparent, intelligible and easily accessible form.

controls.title: Information to be provided at data collection
controls.description: Where personal data are collected from the data subject, the controller shall provide the data subject with information at time of collection.

controls.title: Right to erasure (Right to be forgotten)
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to obtain erasure of personal data concerning them without undue delay.

controls.title: Right to data portability
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to receive personal data concerning them in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.

controls.title: Data protection by design and default
controls.description: The controller shall implement data protection principles in an effective manner and integrate necessary safeguards into processing.

controls.title: Processor agreements
controls.description: Processing by a processor shall be governed by a contract binding the processor with regard to the controller.

controls.title: Records of processing activities (RoPA)
controls.description: Each controller shall maintain a record of processing activities under its responsibility.

controls.title: Security of processing
controls.description: The controller and processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk.

controls.title: Breach notification to supervisory authority
controls.description: In case of a personal data breach, the controller shall notify the supervisory authority within 72 hours.

controls.title: Breach notification to data subjects
controls.description: When a personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to individuals, the controller shall communicate the breach to the data subject.

controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA)
controls.description: Where processing is likely to result in a high risk, the controller shall carry out an assessment of the impact on the protection of personal data.

controls.title: Data Protection Officer (DPO)
controls.description: Where required, the controller shall designate a data protection officer.

controls.title: International data transfers
controls.description: Any transfer of personal data to a third country shall only take place subject to appropriate safeguards.
